notes: meta.json: shop address Pozuelo de Alarcón, Madrid, ES; base currency EUR; description 'Everyday Urban Aesthetics. As Always, With Love'; ships_to_countries includes US, CA, GB, AU.

Best Sellers (78 products): 32 'Man Hoodie Standard' + 5 zipped hoodies, the largest product type; Best Sellers USA (30): 22 standard hoodies + 4 zipped. Hoodies collection 293 listed / 155 served; T-Shirts 342.

Shipping policy: 'United States STANDARD 2-5 DAYS- 10 USD | FREE > 400 USD'; import taxes for the USA (and AU, NZ, CH, UK, KR, JP, CA, AE, SA, SG, MX) 'are covered by Scuffers Partners S.L.'. FAQ: 'All taxes are covered by Scuffers Partners S.L.'

Refund policy/FAQ: 14 days from receipt to request a return or exchange; US return fee $15, US exchange $10; online returns and exchanges available for the USA; Mystery Hoodie/T-shirt not returnable; shipping costs not refunded.
FAQ: 'The fit of our products is oversized.' Raw Butter Hoodie page: 'midweight cotton blend fleece with brushed interior... relaxed fit... double-layer hood and no drawstrings'.

Founded 2018 in Madrid by Jaime Cruz and Javier López, aged 16 and 17 (FashionUnited; ldnfashion, 2026-09-06). FashionUnited: four stores in Spain (Madrid, Valencia, two in Barcelona), pop-ups in London, Amsterdam and Los Angeles; ldnfashion: London pop-up at 52 Brewer Street from Feb 2025. No permanent US store found: us_stores false (stores page renders no text to WebFetch).
